description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat.

uses.name: Everflowing Chalice
uses.cardState: with at least three charge counters on it
